The plan is this tracker rather than a roadmap document, and it is organised
into milestones. Look for what you want there before opening a second issue for
it, and where it is already open, say what you want in that one instead.

## What you want to be able to do

The thing itself, from the position of whoever would use it. Not a design for
how it should work.

## Which client it has to work on

Name the clients it would have to work on for the idea to be worth anything to
you, and their versions.

Say also whether you know of a client that already offers the gesture or the
screen your idea needs. A feature that only works once a client changes is the
thing this plugin exists to avoid, so an idea reachable with what clients
already have is a different proposal from one that is not.

## Which server

Which Jellyfin server version you are asking about. An idea that depends on
something only one server line offers is worth knowing about as that.

## What it would cost

What it would spend, as far as you can tell: calls to a metadata source, rows in
a library database, storage on the server, or something a source's terms of use
speak to. A rough answer is worth more than none.

## Alternatives

What you have already tried, or what you would settle for.
